Elevate your bedroom with our exquisite custom Viking-themed quilt from Jeminise, where Norse mythology meets cozy comfort. Crafted from soft polyester and filled with high-quality silk floss, this quilt offers a perfect balance of warmth and breathability for year-round comfort. Beautifully printed with a detailed Raven and runic circle design, it makes a wonderful personalized gift or a striking addition to your guest bedroom.

Key Features

  • Customizable Design: Personalize your quilt by adding custom text, names of loved ones, or selecting from optional matching pillowcases.
  • Viking Art Style: Features a high-confidence graphic illustration of a Norse Raven centered within a detailed runic circle with Celtic knotwork.
  • Comfort & Warmth: Designed with a breathable soft polyester outer layer and high-quality silk floss filling for luxurious softness.
  • Versatile Use: Perfect for indoor and outdoor use, whether as a bed quilt, throw blanket, picnic mat, or for cozy backyard camping.
  • Available Sizes: Choose from 5 versatile sizes to fit your needs: Throw (60x70 inches), Twin (68x86 inches), Full (80x90 inches), Queen (90x90 inches), and King (91x102 inches).
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, drying quickly to return to its fluffy, comfortable state.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Quilt Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Viking-04
Pattern Tree of Life, Viking
Theme Viking Decor
Seasons All
Customization 1 text input
Care Instructions Machine Wash
